notes: Cấp đủ quyền cần cho toàn vòng đời dự án ngay từ đầu, không cấp nhỏ giọt.
Không dùng Global API Key hoặc wildcard toàn tài khoản nếu quyền project-scoped đáp ứng được.
Secret value không lưu trong repo/Google Sheet/log; chỉ lưu trong GitHub Actions Secrets hoặc secret store phù hợp.

cloudflare.why_no_zone_permissions: Current project bootstrap has no verified active Cloudflare zone/Zone ID for vanhanhdchungyen.cc.cd. Worker is the origin, so intended binding is Workers Custom Domain, not Workers Route. Cloudflare Attach Domain API accepts Workers Scripts Write/Edit. DNS/Workers Routes permissions are not needed for the core Worker+D1 deployment path.
cloudflare.initial_endpoint: workers.dev until primary-domain DNS/zone authority is verified
cloudflare.domain_binding_rule: Do not request CF_ZONE_ID. If an active owned Cloudflare zone is later verified, attach the Custom Domain using the Worker domain API/Wrangler custom_domain flow. Add Zone/DNS/Workers Routes permissions only if a later approved design explicitly needs zone management or Workers Routes.

google_cloud.reason: Personal Gmail/My Drive is used. Service accounts do not have storage quota and are not suitable as the owner of durable project files in personal My Drive; OAuth on behalf of OWNER makes OWNER the file owner and consumes OWNER Drive quota.
google_cloud.drive_scope_note: Full drive scope is required for unattended backend management of the pre-created project root without Google Picker. Because this OAuth technically authorizes the OWNER Drive account, PROJECT_BOUNDARY must fail closed on DRIVE_ROOT_ID and registered resource IDs.
google_cloud.gmail: gmail.send only; no inbox read/modify/delete permissions.

google_drive_chatgpt.rule: ChatGPT Drive operations for this project must stay inside registered new-project resources except explicit read-only legacy reference reads.

domain.permission_implication: Do not request or store CF_ZONE_ID until an active Cloudflare zone is actually verified. Domain binding is a separate DNS-authority prerequisite, not a reason to overgrant the automation token.

manual_owner_actions: Create one Cloudflare custom API token with exactly the five account permissions in this manifest and store it as CF_API_TOKEN; store only CF_ACCOUNT_ID as Cloudflare variable.
Create one new Google Cloud project and enable Drive, Sheets, Gmail and Apps Script APIs.
Create one OWNER OAuth Web Client, authorize the five listed scopes once, and store Client ID, Client Secret and Refresh Token in GitHub Actions Secrets.
Create/link the new Apps Script project and store GAS_SCRIPT_ID plus Google Cloud project ID/number as GitHub variables.
Do not send any secret value in chat.
